entries.en: Signal keeps going... To another terminal...
entries.ro: Semnalul merge mai departe... Spre alt terminal...

entries.en: Ha! I've got a feeling someone's messing with you, V. You'll follow this breadcrumb trail, and when you connect the dots all you'll see is a dick.
entries.ro: Ha! Am senzația că cineva se joacă cu tine, V. Urmezi firimiturile astea, și când legi punctele, tot ce vezi e o pulă.

entries.en: Signal leads here and... And disappears again...

entries.en: Sounds like this Swedenborg really values his privacy.
entries.ro: Pare că Swedenborg ăsta chiar ține la intimitatea lui.

entries.en: Oh. Thought you were done talking to me.
entries.ro: A. Credeam că ai terminat de vorbit cu mine.

entries.en: I was. But it's not like I've got anyone else to talk to. I'd go through your memories, but I don't wanna puke all over your hippocampus.
entries.ro: Eram. Dar n-am cu cine altcineva să vorbesc. Aș scotocii prin amintirile tale, dar nu vreau să-ți vomit pe tot hipocampul.

entries.en: Well, hack away or whatever it is you were gonna do. Please, something happen!
entries.ro: Păi, hack-uiește sau ce-o fi să faci. Te rog, hai să se mai întâmple ceva!

entries.en: I'm sure you'd love that, wouldn't you?

entries.ro: Sunt sigură că ți-ar plăcea, nu?

entries.en: Fuckin' A, I would. That cock would be the first thing Swedenborg did that'd actually make any sense.

entries.en: 'Cept he'd probably give it some pretentious name. Like "Patriarchal phallus upholding toxic masculinity." Whaddaya think?
